events.title: ECMAScript 2023 standardized
events.summary: Ecma adopted ECMAScript 2023 in June 2023 — adding `Array.prototype.findLast`, Hashbang grammar, symbols as WeakMap keys, and `Array.fromAsync`.
events.about: ES2023 filled array and module ergonomics gaps: finding the last matching element without reversing arrays, supporting `#!` in scripts, and async iteration helpers. Annual releases kept browsers aligned on incremental, shippable JavaScript improvements.

narrative.whyChosen: ES2023 added practical array methods developers had polyfilled for years.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers reversed arrays or wrote loops to find the last matching element.
